```{r}
if (!exists("prefix")) {prefix = "peaks5"}
prefix2 = "da"
```

- prefix="`r prefix`" is used to reference the files generated by the pipeline.

```
prefix="`r prefix`" ; rmarkdown::render("04_da.Rmd", output_file=paste0("04_da_", prefix, ".html"))
```


```{r samples, child="samples.Rmd"}
```

```{r inputs}
if (!exists("gse"))             gse = "chip_sa"  ;
if (!exists("model_func_name")) model_func_name = "deseq2"         ;
if (!exists("model_formula"))   model_formula = "~age+BMI+smoking+log2DDEugg44"                     ;
bed_ewas_filename = paste0("ewas4combp_", paste0(gse, "_", prefix, "_", model_func_name, "_", model_formula), ".bed")
da_tsv_filename = paste0("da_", gse, "_", prefix, "_", model_func_name, "_", model_formula, ".tsv")
```

- `model_func_name` = "`r model_func_name`": `deseq2`, size factors estimated on all the features (DESeq2 default); `deseq2ctl`, size factors estimated on the control features only (`controlGenes`, features of type `control` defined by the feature set, e.g. the open sea windows of `99_rmsk.Rmd`: normalization on the background).
- Outputs: ``r da_tsv_filename`` (one line per feature, annotated when the feature set provides `feat_annot`) and, for positional feature sets only, ``r bed_ewas_filename`` (comb-p input). Feature sets with meta-features (several lines of `feat` sharing a name, e.g. `99_rmsk.Rmd`) are not positional: no comb-p.

# Volcano plots


```{r ewas, results="verbatim"}
if (!all(e$gsm %in% colnames(raw_counts))) {stop("problem gsm vs. colnames(raw_counts)")}
countData = raw_counts[,e$gsm]
colnames(countData) = rownames(e)
colData = e[colnames(countData),]
# Vérifie que les noms de colonnes correspondent
if (!all(colnames(countData) == rownames(colData))) {stop("probleme data vs. e")}


k = strsplit(model_formula, "~|\\+")[[1]][2]
  print(k)

  dds <- DESeq2::DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = countData[,rownames(colData[!is.na(colData[,k]),])],
    # samples with NA in the first term are dropped (e.g. status_hi22: within-lot model); droplevels: no empty level of study, experimenter...
    colData = droplevels(colData[!is.na(colData[,k]),]),
    design = formula(model_formula)
  )

  # size factors: on the control features (deseq2ctl) or on all the features (deseq2, DESeq2 default); DESeq() keeps size factors already set
  if (model_func_name == "deseq2ctl") {
    if (!exists("feat_type")) {stop("deseq2ctl: the feature set does not define feat_type (control features)")}
    ctl = rownames(dds) %in% names(feat_type)[feat_type == "control"]
    sf_all = DESeq2::sizeFactors(DESeq2::estimateSizeFactors(dds))
    dds = DESeq2::estimateSizeFactors(dds, controlGenes = ctl)
    print(paste0("size factors on ", sum(ctl), " control features (of ", nrow(dds), ")"))
    print(summary(DESeq2::sizeFactors(dds)))
    print(paste0("Spearman(size factors on the controls, on all the features): ", round(cor(DESeq2::sizeFactors(dds), sf_all, method = "spearman"), 3)))
  } else if (model_func_name != "deseq2") {
    stop(paste0("unknown model_func_name: ", model_func_name))
  }
  dds = DESeq2::DESeq(dds)
  res = DESeq2::results(dds, name=DESeq2::resultsNames(dds)[2])

  # stop("EFN")
  # head(res[is.na(res$pvalue),])
  # sum(!is.na(res$pvalue))
  # sum(is.na(res$pvalue))
  # sum(!is.na(res$padj))
  # res = res[!is.na(res$pvalue),]
  # # res = res[!is.na(res$padj),]

  layout(matrix(1:2,1), respect=TRUE)
  plot(res$log2FoldChange, -log10(res$pvalue), xlab="l2fc", ylab="-log10(pval)", main=model_formula)
  plot(res$log2FoldChange, -log10(res$padj)  , xlab="l2fc", ylab="-log10(padj)", main=model_formula)

  # res = res[order(res$log2FoldChange), ]
  idx = rownames(res)[!is.na(res$padj)&res$padj< 0.05]
  is_meta = any(duplicated(feat[,4]))   # meta-features: not positional (no comb-p, no position in pf)
  if (is_meta) {
    idx = idx[order(res[idx, "padj"])]
    ann = if (exists("feat_annot")) feat_annot[idx, intersect(c("type", "class", "family"), colnames(feat_annot)), drop = FALSE] else NULL
    print(paste0("features with padj < 0.05: ", length(idx), " (top 50)"))
    print(head(cbind(ann, as.data.frame(res[idx, c("baseMean", "log2FoldChange", "pvalue", "padj")])), 50))
  } else {
    print(cbind(pf[idx,1:3], res[idx, c("log2FoldChange", "pvalue", "padj") ]))
  }

  # results table, one line per feature (annotated when the feature set provides feat_annot)
  da_tab = data.frame(feature = rownames(res), as.data.frame(res), check.names = FALSE)
  if (exists("feat_annot")) {da_tab = cbind(da_tab, feat_annot[da_tab$feature, setdiff(colnames(feat_annot), "feature"), drop = FALSE])}
  write.table(da_tab, file = da_tsv_filename, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
  if (exists("feat_annot")) {
    # features with padj < 0.05 by type and class, up and down
    sig = da_tab[!is.na(da_tab$padj) & da_tab$padj < 0.05, ]
    sm = aggregate(feature ~ type + class, da_tab, length); colnames(sm)[3] = "features"
    sm$up   = sapply(seq_len(nrow(sm)), function(i) sum(sig$type == sm$type[i] & sig$class == sm$class[i] & sig$log2FoldChange > 0))
    sm$down = sapply(seq_len(nrow(sm)), function(i) sum(sig$type == sm$type[i] & sig$class == sm$class[i] & sig$log2FoldChange < 0))
    print(sm[order(-(sm$up + sm$down), sm$type), ], row.names = FALSE)
  }


  tmp_df = if (!is_meta) cbind(pf[rownames(res),], res) else NULL   # pf: positions (lists of positions for meta-features)
  # prefix3 = paste0(gse, "_", model_func_name, "_", model_formula)
  # WriteXLS::WriteXLS(tmp_df, paste0("results_", prefix3, "_", prefix2, "_", prefix, ".xlsx"))

  # gsea_input = cbind(rownames(tmp_df), tmp_df$log2FoldChange)
  # head(gsea_input)
  # dim(gsea_input)
  # gsea_input_filename = paste0("results_", prefix3, "_", prefix2, "_", prefix, ".rnk")
  # write.table(gsea_input, gsea_input_filename, sep="\t", row.names=FALSE, col.names=FALSE, quote=FALSE)

  if (!is_meta) {
  bed = tmp_df
  head(bed)
  # position given to comb-p: peak summit (narrow peaks, feat$summit from 99_peaks.Rmd),
  # feature center otherwise (e.g. broad peaks, tiles); 0-based, from feat (BED-like)
  if (!all(rownames(bed) %in% rownames(feat))) {stop("features in counts not found in feat")}
  if ("summit" %in% colnames(feat)) {
    pos = feat[rownames(bed), "summit"]
  } else {
    pos = floor((feat[rownames(bed), "chromStart"] + feat[rownames(bed), "chromEnd"]) / 2)
  }
  bed[,2] = pos
  bed[,3] = bed[,2]+1
  bed[,4] = rownames(bed)
  # DESeq2 NA p-values (all-zero counts, Cook's outliers, ...): set to 1 (and l2fc to 0) to keep the probes in comb-p without signal
  print(paste0("NA pvalues set to 1: ", sum(is.na(bed$pvalue))))
  bed[,5] = ifelse(is.na(bed$pvalue), 1, bed$pvalue)
  bed[,6] = "+"
  bed[,7] = ifelse(is.na(bed$log2FoldChange), 0, bed$log2FoldChange)
  bed[,8] = -log10(bed[,5])  
  bed = bed[,1:8]
  colnames(bed) = c("#chrom", "start", "end", "probes", "pval", "strand", "l2fc", "lpv")
  head(bed)
  dim(bed)

  # write ewas res for combp
  bed[,1] = as.character(bed[,1])
  bed = bed[order(bed[,1], bed[,2]),]
  write.table(bed, file=bed_ewas_filename , sep="\t", quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE, col.names=TRUE)
  # bed_on_disk = read.table(bed_ewas_filename, sep="\t", header=TRUE)
  }

```
